tlHeroBadge: YunJing ZhiZhan · International Public Procurement Workshop
tlHeroSubtitle: See Orders · Understand Rules · Assist Bidding · Light Accompaniment
tlHeroDesc: For foreign trade companies, manufacturers, trading firms and overseas service agencies. Systematically learn the underlying rules, bidding paths and practical methods of UN and international public procurement.
tlHeroSuitable: Suitable for: foreign trade owners / business heads / bidding specialists / supply chain leaders / new teams exploring international public procurement
tlWhyTitle: Why Foreign Trade Companies Need International Public Procurement
tlWhySubtitle: Not a price-war red ocean, but an incremental market valuing compliance, responsiveness and sustained performance
tlWhy1Desc: UN, international organizations and overseas government projects continuously publish real procurement needs, expanding customer channels beyond traditional trade.
tlWhy2Desc: Systematically understand compliance, qualifications, tenders, pricing and delivery rules, upgrading from 'making products' to 'doing business by international rules'.
tlWhy3Desc: Not a one-off lecture, but building underlying capabilities in sourcing, judging, bidding and team coordination for repeatable deals.
tlValue1Desc: Read the underlying logic of international public procurement
tlValue2Desc: Learn platforms, channels and opportunity screening
tlValue3Desc: Hands-on explanation of RFQ / ITB / RFP core rules
tlValue4Desc: From qualification prep to response framework
tlValue5Desc: Connect consultants, experts, peers and follow-up services
tlSyllabusTitle: Curriculum: From Seeing Orders to Assisted Execution
tlModule1Item1: Panoramic view of international public procurement
tlModule1Item2: Differences among UN / multilateral / overseas government procurement
tlModule1Item4: How to quickly judge if an order is worth pursuing
tlModule2Item1: Hands-on paths on UNGM and other platforms
tlModule2Item2: How to read key tender fields
tlModule2Item3: Breakdown of qualification, technical and commercial requirements
tlModule3Item2: Basic logic of pricing and response
tlModule3Item4: Ongoing consulting, membership and accompaniment support

tlPlanBDesc: For bosses bringing core teams together
tlPlanCDesc: For companies systematically entering international public procurement
tlInstructorsSubtitle: Instructors teach around real orders, real rules and real service scenarios, not just concepts.

tlHighlight2Desc: Grounded teaching on platforms, tenders, documents and bidding strategy, ideal for enterprise teams.
tlHighlight3Desc: The course is not the end — it links to membership, consulting, accompaniment and order services.
